name: The Shadow
source:
Caught between a dangerous vampire and a determined hunter, Sara has to find a way to stop the carnage in time.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Shadow]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
萨拉夹在一个危险的吸血鬼和一个意志坚定的猎人之间，必须及时找到办法阻止这场杀戮。
